verdict.rationale: Bolna has batch calling as a first-party concept: the CLI manages batches, and the Workflows feature builds outbound outreach sequences with waits and retries through the API. The evidence never documents batch scheduling (start times or recurring windows) or throughput controls such as concurrency or rate limits; the 'thousands of calls every minute' line is marketing capacity, not a user-facing control. missing for 10: documented batch scheduling, configurable throughput/concurrency limits, in-depth batch campaign docs, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, I can run batch outbound call campaigns with scheduling and throughput controls
